Two typists work at constant rates. Typist A types 350 words in 5 minutes. Typist B types 420 words in 7 minutes. Who types faster? Enter 1 for A or 2 for B.
Solution: A: 350/5 = 70 words/min; B: 420/7 = 60 words/min. A is faster → answer 1.
